devdoc.author: Tim Clancy This staking contract disburses tokens from its internal reservoir according to a fixed emission schedule. Assets can be assigned varied staking weights. This code is inspired by and modified from Sushi's Master Chef contract. https://github.com/sushiswap/sushiswap/blob/master/contracts/MasterChef.sol

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

devdoc.title: An asset staking contract.

addDeveloper(address,uint256).notice: Add a new developer to the Staker or overwrite an existing one. This operation requires that developer address addition is not locked.

addPool(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Allows the contract owner to add a new asset pool to the Staker or overwrite an existing one.

approvePointSpender(address,bool).notice: Allows the owner of this Staker to grant or remove approval to an external spender of the points that users accrue from staking resources.

methods.constructor: Construct a new Staker by providing it a name and the token to disburse.

deposit(address,uint256).notice: Deposit some particular assets to a particular pool on the Staker.

getAvailablePoints(address).notice: Return the number of points that the user has available to spend.

getDeveloperCount().notice: Returns the length of the developer address array.

getPendingPoints(address,address).notice: A function to easily see the amount of point rewards pending for a user on a given pool. Returns the pending reward point amount.

getPendingTokens(address,address).notice: A function to easily see the amount of token rewards pending for a user on a given pool. Returns the pending reward token amount.

getPoolCount().notice: Returns the length of the staking pool array.

getRemainingToken().notice: Returns the amount of token that has not been disbursed by the Staker yet.

getSpentPoints(address).notice: Return the total number of points that the user has ever spent.

getTotalEmittedPoints(uint256,uint256).notice: Uses the emission schedule to calculate the total amount of points emitted between two specified block numbers.

getTotalEmittedTokens(uint256,uint256).notice: Uses the emission schedule to calculate the total amount of staking reward token that was emitted between two specified block numbers.

getTotalPoints(address).notice: Return the total number of points that the user has ever accrued.

lockDevelopers().notice: Permanently forfeits owner ability to alter the state of Staker developers. Once called, this function is intended to give peace of mind to the Staker's developers and community that the fee structure is now immutable.

lockPointEmissions().notice: Permanently forfeits owner ability to alter the emission schedule. Once called, this function is intended to give peace of mind to the Staker's developers and community that the inflation rate is now immutable.

lockTokenEmissions().notice: Permanently forfeits owner ability to alter the emission schedule. Once called, this function is intended to give peace of mind to the Staker's developers and community that the inflation rate is now immutable.

setEmissions((uint256,uint256)[],(uint25.notice: Set new emission details to the Staker or overwrite existing ones. This operation requires that emission schedule alteration is not locked.

spendPoints(address,uint256).notice: Allows an approved spender of points to spend points on behalf of a user.

updateDeveloper(address,uint256).notice: A developer may at any time update their address or voluntarily reduce their share of emissions by calling this function from their current address. Note that updating a developer's share to zero effectively removes them.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw some particular assets from a particular pool on the Staker.
